description: Apple announced that its second Mumbai store, Apple Borivali, will open later this month. This marks the company’s sixth retail outlet in India and comes three years after Apple BKC, its first store in the country. Apple Borivali will provide customer support and host Today at Apple sessions, similar to Apple BKC, Apple Saket, Apple Hebbal, Apple Noida, and Apple Koregaon Park.
title: Apple Borivali to Open on February 26 as Sixth Apple Store in India

description: Huawei has teased the Mate 80 Pro’s global design ahead of its February 26 launch event in Madrid. A post on X highlights the Dual Space Ring rear design with a large circular XMAGE-branded camera module and a subtle secondary ring below it. The phone is shown in a Dawn Gold finish with a near edge-to-edge display. In China, it runs HarmonyOS 6.0, uses a Kirin 9030 Pro chip, and packs a 50-megapixel RYYB camera system. Huawei will also unveil new wearables, earbuds, and a tablet at the global launch event.
title: Huawei Mate 80 Pro Design Teased Ahead of February 26 Global Launch Event

description: Infinix Note 60 Ultra is confirmed to launch soon. Now, the phone has appeared in a Geekbench listing, which has suggested its possible model number and specifications. The Infinix Note 60 Ultra is expected to come with a MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset and 12GB RAM. The Infinix Note 60 Pro is already confirmed to launch in select markets soon.
title: Infinix Note 60 Ultra Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Features Including Dimensity 8000 Series Chip

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is scheduled to be launched in India and the global markets later this month. While the company has yet to reveal any details about the flagship lineup, its design and colour options have surfaced in what appear to be leaked official marketing images. The leaked images indicate that the Galaxy S26 and S26+ will continue with Samsung’s familiar flat display and slim-bezel design, while the Ultra model retains its more squared-off profile.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Design, Colour Options Surface Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked

description: Santa Monica Studio shadow dropped a new God of War game at Sony's State of Play livestream. God of War Sons of Sparta, a 2D action-platformer, is now out of the PS5. Co-developed with Mega Cat Studios, the game follows the journey of young Kratos as he trains to become a Spartan warrior. Santa Monica also revealed that a remake of God of War Greek trilogy was in early development.
title: Sony Shadow Drops Action-Platformer God of War Sons of Sparta, Reveals God of War Greek Trilogy Remake

description: Sony WF-1000XM6 was launched in the global markets on Thursday. The truly wireless stereo (TWS) earphones from the Japanese tech giant arrive as the successor to the WF-1000XM5, promising several upgrades under the hood. It is claimed to offer up to 25 percent better active noise cancellation (ANC) compared to its predecessor, courtesy of four microphones. The Sony WF-1000XM6 are claimed to offer up to 8 hours of battery life under typical use.
title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Launched With Improved Active Noise Cancellation, Gemini Support: Price, Specifications
